jobs.title: Head of Systems Engineering
jobs.description:
Own the system-level vision that turns first-of-a-kind fusion hardware into a cohesive, scalable reality—leading the integration of breakthrough science and engineering on the path to commercial fusion energy.  
The Head of Systems Engineering will lead the systems engineering function at   Realta  Fusion,  establishing  technical requirements, driving system integration, and ensuring our magnetic mirror fusion devices meet performance, safety, and operational  objectives . This senior technical leadership role demands  expertise  in complex system architecture, requirements management, and integration of multidisciplinary subsystems. You will bridge plasma physics, mechanical, electrical, nuclear, and  controls  engineering teams to ensure coherent system design and successful execution from experimental devices through commercial deployment. The ideal candidate combines deep systems engineering  expertise  with strategic leadership, thriving in a first-of-a-kind hardware environment where disciplined systems thinking directly  impacts  our ability to deliver commercial fusion energy.    
Realta Fusion is a rapidly growing start-up developing compact magnetic mirror fusion energy systems to address the biggest challenge of our time – tackling global climate change while ensuring a sufficient energy supply for at least ten billion people on (and off) earth. We are building a team with diverse talents dedicated to making fusion energy a  real  solution to humanity’s most pressing problem .  
Key Responsibilities

Systems Architecture & Requirements

Define and maintain system architecture for fusion devices across experimental, pilot, and commercial product lines 
Establish and manage technical requirements from physics performance through operational, safety, and regulatory constraints 
Lead system decomposition and allocation of requirements to subsystems and components  
Develop and  maintain  interface control documents across mechanical, electrical, plasma, and control systems  
Drive design trades balancing performance, cost, schedule, manufacturability, and risk    

Integration & Verification

Lead system integration activities ensuring subsystems work together to meet top-level requirements 
Define verification and validation strategy including analysis, testing, inspection, and demonstration 
Oversee commissioning and acceptance testing of fusion devices and major subsystems  
Manage technical reviews (PDR, CDR, TRR) ensuring design maturity and readiness  
Drive resolution of integration issues and  interface  conflicts across engineering disciplines    

Team Leadership & Development

Build, lead, and mentor systems engineering team (initially 2-3, scaling to 8-12)  
Establish systems engineering processes, tools, and best practices for fusion development 
Recruit systems engineers with experience in complex hardware integration    
Develop systems engineering capability across the broader engineering organization    

Cross-Functional Technical Leadership

Partner with plasma physics to translate physics requirements into engineering specifications  
Work with mechanical, electrical, nuclear, and controls leads to ensure integrated system design  
Coordinate with operations on maintainability, operability, and lifetime performance requirements    
Support manufacturing and assembly planning to ensure buildability and integration sequence  

Program Support & Risk Management

Provide systems engineering support to experimental campaigns and pilot plant development programs 
Lead technical risk assessment and develop mitigation strategies for system-level risks 
Support project management with integrated schedules, technical dependencies, and critical path analysis    
Represent systems engineering perspective in executive decision-making on technical priorities and resource allocation    

  External Engagement

Represent systems engineering capabilities to investors, partners, and technical stakeholders  
Collaborate with national laboratories and research institutions on systems engineering best practices for fusion 
Engage with regulatory agencies on system safety analysis and compliance strategies    

Qualifications

Education & Experience

BS in Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related technical discipline. Advanced degree preferred 
15+ years systems engineering experience in complex hardware programs (aerospace, defense, energy, accelerators, research facilities)  
5+ years leading systems engineering teams or serving as chief engineer on major programs    
Demonstrated  track record  integrating multidisciplinary systems from requirements through commissioning    

Technical Expertise

Deep expertise in systems engineering processes including requirements management, functional analysis, interface management, and V&V  
Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical and control systems to  facilitate  integration across disciplines    
Proficiency  with systems engineering tools (DOORS, Cameo,  modeling  and simulation)    
Experience with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) approaches    
Knowledge of systems safety analysis (FMEA, fault trees, hazard analysis)    
Familiarity with technical reviews, configuration management, and engineering change processes    

Leadership & Execution

Proven ability to lead technical teams and influence across organizational boundaries 
Strong analytical and problem solving skills with systems-level thinking  
Excellent communication skills translating between technical specialists and executive leadership    
Experience making critical technical decisions with incomplete information and competing constraints    
Comfortable in fast-paced environments balancing rigor with speed of execution

About This Role

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Manager of Data Protection Engineering to lead the transformation of the enterprise data protection platform. This leader will drive the modernization of backup, recovery, cyber resilience, and data security capabilities across on-premises, hybrid, and public cloud environments. A key focus of this role will be accelerating the adoption of modern data protection platform, enabling cloud-integrated recovery services, cyber vaulting, ransomware resilience, and operational automation at enterprise scale.

This leader will be responsible for a geographically distributed engineering organization supporting more than 500 PBs of protected data across critical business applications and infrastructure. The role requires strong technical leadership, strategic planning, and execution capabilities to deliver resilient, compliant, and cost-effective data protection services that align with Wells Fargo's cloud transformation and cyber resilience objectives.

The Senior Manager will partner closely with Infrastructure Engineering teams, Cybersecurity, Architecture, Risk, Application Development, and CIO teams to develop and execute a multi-year roadmap that modernizes the enterprise data protection ecosystem and enables greater self-service, automation, and cloud adoption.

In This Role, You Will

Define and execute the enterprise data protection strategy, aligning with cloud, cyber resilience, and infrastructure modernization initiatives
Lead the transition from traditional backup architectures to modern, policy-driven platforms leveraging cloud-native protection services, immutable storage, and cyber recovery capabilities
Drive adoption of hybrid and multi-cloud data protection solutions across GCP, Azure, and AWS environments
Develop long-term roadmaps that improve recovery outcomes, reduce operational complexity, and optimize infrastructure costs
Ensure data protection services support evolving business, regulatory, and resiliency requirements
Engineering Leadership
Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of engineers focused on platform engineering, automation, cloud integration, and service reliability
Establish engineering standards, automation frameworks, and operational practices that improve scalability and reduce manual effort
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence
Drive modernization initiatives focused on Infrastructure as Code, API-driven automation, self-service consumption, and platform engineering principles
Cyber Resilience & Risk Management
Partner with Cybersecurity teams to enhance ransomware protection, cyber recovery, immutable storage strategies, and recovery testing programs.
Ensure engineering solutions meet enterprise security, compliance, governance, audit, and regulatory requirements
Lead resiliency assessments and recovery readiness initiatives to improve recovery point objectives (RPO) and recovery time objectives (RTO)
Identify and mitigate operational, security, and technology risks across the data protection ecosystem
Vendor & Technology Management
Serve as the executive engineering partner for strategic vendors including Cohesity and cloud providers
Influence product roadmaps, feature prioritization, and platform enhancements to meet enterprise requirements
Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends in cyber resilience, cloud backup, AI-driven operations, and data security
Drive technology lifecycle management and modernization efforts across the backup and recovery portfolio

As a Team Member Manager, you are expected to achieve success by leading yourself, your team, and the business. Specifically, you will:
Lead with integrity and create an environment where team members feel included, valued, and empowered to perform at their highest potential
Drive a culture focused on engineering excellence, automation, self-service adoption, and customer-centric delivery
Develop organizational capabilities through coaching, mentoring, succession planning, and talent development
Manage performance, risk, financial stewardship, and strategic execution while fostering collaboration across organizational boundaries

Required Qualifications:

7+ years of Infrastructure Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
3+ years of management or leadership experience
Experience leading large-scale infrastructure or platform engineering teams supporting mission-critical environments

Desired Qualifications

Deep expertise in enterprise data protection, backup and recovery, cyber resilience, and business continuity solutions
Strong experience with Cohesity and modern enterprise backup platforms, including Rubrik, NetBackup, Data Domain, or similar technologies
Experience protecting workloads across hybrid cloud environments including Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure, and Amazon Web Services (AWS)
Knowledge of cloud-native backup, disaster recovery, immutable storage, cyber vaulting, and ransomware recovery architectures
Experience developing and executing technology modernization and cloud transformation roadmaps
Strong understanding of automation, Infrastructure as Code, API integration, and platform engineering practices
Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders and communicate technology strategy to senior leadership
Experience partnering with Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, and Architecture organizations
Strong strategic planning, organizational leadership, and vendor management skills
Experience operating large-scale infrastructure environments with high availability, resiliency, and regulatory requirements
Agile delivery and product-oriented operating model experience preferred
Exceptional verbal, written, and executive communication skills

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Engineering - AI Agents
new_jobs.description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.

The Senior Manager, Engineering - AI Agents will lead the development and delivery of Five9’s AI Agent software platform, which provides customers with fully autonomous self-service agents for customer support, sales, and services use cases in the contact center. This is one of the hottest areas of application for AI Agent technology!

This role is responsible for building and managing a high-performing engineering team that develops scalable, reliable, and production-grade AI-powered systems used in real-time customer conversations.

You will be responsible for hiring and developing engineers, improving engineering processes, and enabling strong execution across the software development lifecycle. While this is a management role rather than an individual contributor position, the ideal candidate will bring strong technical credibility with engineers and guide architecture discussions, technical decisions, and engineering best practices.

You will collaborate closely with Product, SRE, Support, and other engineering teams to deliver an enterprise-grade platform while fostering a culture of operational excellence, ownership, and customer empathy.

This role is hybrid. 3 days a week (M, W, TH) in our San Francisco office is required.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development

Hire, onboard, and grow a high-performing engineering teamof 4-8 engineers in the United States
Provide coaching, mentorship, and career development for engineers
Establish clear ownership, accountability, and engineering rigor
Conduct performance management, feedback, and growth planning
Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and operational excellence
Mentor senior engineers and emerging technical leaders

Delivery & Execution

Lead planning and enable strong execution of engineering initiatives and product roadmap
Ensure projects are delivered predictably and with high quality
Focus on customer success, ensuring quality AI agent experiences with low latency and high accuracy
Break down large initiatives into achievable milestones
Partner with Product Management to prioritize work and manage trade-offs
Collaborate with Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) teams on AI agent implementations
Drive continuous improvement in development processes and team productivity

Technical Leadership

Perform code reviews, guide software architecture andtechnical decisions
Review technical designs and ensure sound engineering practices
Help teams make pragmatic technology decisions balancing innovation and reliability
Drive the team to manage customer expectations of uptime and performance by defining and reviewing SLO/SLI's, developing metrics to measuring as such and maintainingfor all the services
Ensure systems are scalable, maintainable, and production-ready

Operational Excellence

Promote strong service ownership and reliability culture
Ensure effective on-call practices and incident response processes
Drive root cause analysis and continuous reliability improvements
Partner with SRE teams to define SLIs, SLOs, and operational metrics
Handle customer escalations and issues related to AI Agent quality
Participate in on-call escalation rotations for provided services

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with Product, UX, SRE, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) and Support teams
Align engineering execution with product strategy and customer needs
Communicate engineering progress, risks, and technical decisions clearly to stakeholders

AI-Augmented Engineering Practices

Use of modern AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity, and represent “best in class” examples of how to effectively use it
Help the team adopt responsible and effective use of AI in software development workflows
Evaluate emerging developer AI tools and incorporate them wherebeneficial
Promote experimentation and learning around AI-enabled engineering practices

Required Experience

3+ years experience leading or managing software engineering teams
8+ years professional software development experience
Experience participatingin hiring and helping grow engineering teams
5+ years experience developing enterprise SaaS software
Strong background in distributed systems and modern software architectures
Experience or exposure to GenAI / LLM-based systems
Experience using or adopting AI-assisted software development tools
Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar
Strong track recordin hiring outstanding software development teams, through rigorous interviewing and vetting processes – either as the hiring manager or as part of interview panels

Desired Experience

1+ years of experience building AI Agent platforms for CX, including voicebots, chatbots and AI assistants

Technical Background

While this role is primarily management-focused, candidates must have sufficient technical depth to guide architecture and mentor engineers.

Software Engineering

Strong background in Java or JVM-based backend systems
Experience designing distributed systems or microservices architectures
Familiarity with API design (REST/gRPC) and scalable service architectures

AI / GenAI Platforms

Familiarity with LLM-based systems, prompt engineering, AI Agent architectures and design patterns
Understanding of common AI platform patterns such as embeddings, RAG pipelines, or model integration
Awareness of performance and reliability considerations for AI-backed systems

Cloud & Infrastructure

Experience building SaaS platforms in public cloud environments (GCP preferred but not required)
Familiarity with microservices architectures and cloud-native systems
Basic understanding of networking concepts such as load balancing, service-to-service communication, and API gateways

Operational Excellence

Experience operating production services in enterprise SaaS environments
Familiarity with observability practices (metrics, logging, tracing)
Experience participating in or leading incident response and root cause analysis

Leadership & Collaboration Skills

Proven ability to build and develop strong engineering teams
Strong mentoring and coaching capabilities
Ability to guide engineers through technical design and problem solving
Excellent communication skills across engineering and product organizations
Ability to align teams around clear priorities and ownership

Hire a strong engineering team delivering reliable AI platform capabilities
Predictable and high-quality delivery of engineering initiatives for our core AI Agent platform
Clear engineering ownership and operational accountability
Customer obsession resulting in customer satisfaction with AI Agent quality, latency and accuracy
Scalable and maintainable platform architecture
Engineers effectively leveraging AI-assisted development tools
A culture of accountability, collaboration, and technical excellence
